newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday January 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday January 20.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* Prime Minister Romano Prodi urges farmers to halt their protests over European Union milk quotas and remove their barricades at Milan's Linate airport (all)
* Train engineers will slow down high-speed trains during a seven-day long protest over security isssues (Corriere della Sera, La Stampa)
* The leader of hard-right National Alliance, Gianfranco Fini, says in an interview that he will back Prodi's privatisation programmes but not his government (La Stampa).
* Italian Treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi meets European Commissioner Karel Van Miert in Brussels today to reassure him over state telecom holding STET privatisation programme (all)
* State airline Alitalia to increase tariffs by 3 percent (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
